label: api36-4k-one-command
scope: One-command offscreen sampling/render-pipeline run: generate deterministic BC1/BC3/RGBA8 inputs, decode them with the pinned host bcdec reference, compile the committed shaders, build and stage the Android fixture, boot the 4 KB AVD VaporProbe36C, run the 31-case matrix through the system loader and the pinned wrapper candidate/baseline (compute, compute-view, host-cpu decode), read the rendered images back and check them against the expected images. Software Vulkan emulator only; no phone/Adreno result claimed.

fixture.toolchain: NDK 27.3.13750724 aarch64-linux-android34-clang, 16 KB max/common page-size flags

bcdec.license: MIT OR Unlicense (bcdec.h alternative A = MIT, alternative B = The Unlicense)

independent_python_reference.use: deterministic input generation and a second decoder for the cross-check
